title: Compose daily and weekly digest files from letters and usage records
action: Per D3 (store id dbbe0778) and D1 (b610a1dc): new module packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src/verbs/mailbox_digest.rs, registered in verbs/mod.rs. It derives finished-and-undigested periods from directory names alone: letter filenames are UTC-stamp-led (anchor mailbox.rs:177 'pub(crate) fn letter_filename(filed_at: &str, run: &str) -> String {'), digests are named digest-YYYY-MM-DD.md (UTC day) and digest-YYYY-Www.md (ISO week) in the same .bee/human-mailbox/ directory. compose_due_digests(root, now) composes, oldest first, every period that (a) has fully ended in UTC, (b) has 1+ letters by filename stamp, (c) has no digest file yet — idempotent by digest-file existence, never reopening an existing digest. The digest is a RENDERER, never a summarizer (mailbox D8): group the period's letters by project/feature, transcribe letter subjects and their Done / Broken or unfinished / Needs your call bullets via the existing letter reader, and transcribe per-feature .bee/usage/<feature>.json fields verbatim for records whose closed_at (anchor close.rs:2185 '"closed_at": closed_at,', path anchor close.rs:2227 'let rel = format!(".bee/usage/{feature}.json");') falls in the period. NO computed aggregates: no counts, no totals bee did not store, no mood lines (advisor P3). Digest frontmatter carries type: digest plus a readable subject line. Make letter-only surfaces skip digests: list_letter_files (mailbox.rs:188-199) and letter_run_slugs must ignore names starting 'digest-' so digests never enter D12's lettered set or get folded as letters (advisor P1). A torn or unreadable letter is skipped with a stderr warning; the digest still composes from the readable rest. A D12-recovered letter digests under its filed_at day. Tests per the plan's ld-2 triad; judge existing coverage first.

truths: A finished UTC day with letters and no digest gains exactly one digest-YYYY-MM-DD.md on compose_due_digests; a finished ISO week likewise gains digest-YYYY-Www.md
Re-running compose_due_digests writes nothing new (idempotent by file existence)
list_letter_files and letter_run_slugs never return digest-* files

artifacts.substantive: period detection from names, daily+weekly composer folding letters and usage records, with tests

key_links: verbs/mod.rs registers mailbox_digest; the composer reads letters through mailbox.rs's existing letter reader
prohibitions: No fact in a digest body that no letter or stored usage field carries (D8)
No verb, no CLI surface, no viewer (D1); composing is library code only
Never rewrite or reopen an existing digest file

deviations: Periods compose ordered by the date they ENDED, not the date they started — a week starts before the days inside it, so a start-ordered pass wrote the week digest before the Tuesday digest it contains — found a better route

The digest frontmatter carries an unreadable[] list beside letters[] — the plan only said a torn letter is skipped with a stderr warning, which would let a torn letter vanish from the record with nothing kept — something else had to be fixed first
